mae_reduction_pct.definition: XGBoost 60-Min Ex-Ante Corridor MAE reduction vs strongest historical baseline (MAE 39.35 vs 50.24).

wape.definition: Citywide Weighted Absolute Percentage Error across 56,781 holdout test slots.

r2.definition: Coefficient of determination (R²) for 60-min ex-ante passenger arrivals.

roc_auc.definition: Receiver Operating Characteristic AUC for DCR > 1.0 overcrowding early warning.

pr_auc.definition: Precision-Recall AUC across all 56,781 test route-hours.

wide_net.definition: Stage 1 candidate screening (DCR >= 1.0, 60-min lead time) across entire network.

priority_queue.definition: Stage 2 operator dispatch queue precision (capped at top 50 high-confidence cards/day).

anomalies_flagged.definition: Telemetry anomalies flagged and isolated by Isolation Forest prior to dispatch scoring.

rebalancing.definition: Strict single-allocation same-depot rebalancing with >= 70 pax minimum benefit rule (donor cap DCR <= 0.80x).
